The window transition uses `genie-web` 0.1.3 by fenx, under the MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/fenxer/genie-web
License: `genie-web/LICENSE`

Panel snapshots use `html2canvas` 1.4.1 by Niklas von Hertzen, under the MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas
License: `html2canvas-LICENSE`

Both libraries are bundled locally. The animation does not load code from a CDN.
